# Native compatibility fixture

`BF240_output_v02.TSC` is an unchanged copy of the user-supplied TINA document,
not output generated by the browser codec.

SHA-256: `8f4342e5e0c0a7e9d668c0c69714cf23a5eef4687b67da016cc36329548e39e3`.

The independent Python-builder preset oracle files are not present in this
checkout. Their original assertions remain available via `TINA_PYTHON_ORACLES`
(directory containing `BF240_output_v03.TSC`, `BF240_input.TSC`, and
`BF240_basics.TSC`). When unavailable this check is explicitly reported as
skipped; browser-generated bytes are never substituted for those references.
